posts.text: I will make a deal: If you are in these comments claiming there is evidence that the 2020 election was stolen, present it. If you show me the evidence and it actually stumps me — I can't explain it, I can't debunk it, I can't show you why it's nonsense — I'll Venmo you $1,000.

It has been six years. Every single "stolen election" theory — from 2,000 Mules to servers in Italy to Georgia suitcases — has been debunked, crushed in court, painstakingly explained, and none of these guys ever have the goods cause it's all nonsense to please POTUS. It's embarrassing for Bartiromo that she is still giving this airtime, and anyone who still falls for this chasing the next new reveal needs to get away from their computer.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

BARTIROMO: So you believe there

We were one vote away (Fetterman) from Vice President Vance having to cast a tie breaking vote on a war powers resolution.


NewsWire (@NewsWire_US)
